comparison.objective: Develop an exposed wafer using a manually timed immersion.
comparison.physical_skill: Handle and immerse a wafer for a controlled duration, then remove it.
comparison.success_condition: Full immersion lasts 28–32 seconds; chemistry is explicitly a time-based surrogate and other handling thresholds are not detailed.
comparison.reason: Timed liquid-process handling differs from fine mechanical adjustment, locking, and repeated force/travel-qualified impacts.
